page: Google Cloud Platform ct5l-hightpu-1t is a specialized accelerator instance belonging to the ct5l server family. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 48 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The defining hardware component of this instance is a single integrated Google TPU v5e accelerator equipped with 16 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. This hardware profile is engineered specifically for machine learning workloads, including neural network training, fine-tuning, and inference tasks. The 1:2 ratio of vCPUs to system memory aligns with compute-heavy processing pipelines that feed data directly to the TPU.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ct5l-hightpu-1t provides a specialized entry point for TPU-accelerated computing compared to larger multi-TPU configurations. However, users must note the complete absence of local storage, meaning all data persistence and dataset staging must rely on network-attached storage or cloud storage buckets, which may introduce network I/O considerations during training.
